EXERCISE — FICTIONAL

1. Collection against Torvik during the reporting period establishes that ostravik (A-411) and Kalvar (A-417) berth at quay 4.

2. Entities identified in this reporting: Ostravik (A-411), Kalvar (A-417), 3rd Naval Auxiliary Group.

3. The transmission was made in the clear on a working frequency, which is consistent with routine administrative traffic rather than deliberate deception.

4. A gap in collection between 1624Z and 0028Z cannot be excluded, and activity during that window would not have been recovered.

5. The reporting establishes that the activity occurred but not why it was ordered.
